output: Scientific Hypothesis: There is no strong or statistically significant relationship between time preference factors (such as DISSAVED and SAMESAVE) and BMI in the 1989 data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79). This is supported by the weak correlations observed in the correlation matrix and the lack of p-values indicating statistical significance. The variables DISSAVED and SAMESAVE, which represent time preference behaviors, do not appear to be strongly associated with BMI in this dataset.
